scope: Static VDensHO1 internal-pump capability/configuration objects discovered after the FlowCalibration/host-selector negative result.

values.2: shared K30 value label: drehzahlgeregelt mit Volumenstrom

events.profile_visibility: hidden when K30 / internal-pump ID is 0 stufig

host_analysis.flowcalibration_result: negative for a new volatile WB2A runtime-pump override
host_analysis.focused_selector_search: no host-side 0x0A3C/0x7660 arbitration algorithm found in the focused decompiled candidates
host_analysis.consequence: The hidden runtime selector upstream of 0x0A3C remains controller-firmware/MCU territory, but K30/K31/0x0A54 can now characterize the installed internal-pump capability and role before firmware work.

interpretation_boundary: Do not write 0x5730 or 0x5731 during characterization; both are configuration objects and may be persistent.
K31 is not assumed to be a volatile runtime override.
K30=2 would prove that the controller configuration distinguishes an internal-pump mode with volume-flow capability; it would not by itself identify a readable volume-flow datapoint.
The Wilo/Grundfos 0x10B0/0x10C0 coding-plug blocks are diverter-valve motion profiles, not internal-circulation-pump speed controls.
